item.tib: spu rgyal gnas kyi dkar chags don gsal sgron ma
item.coloph: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba'i rtsal gyis spu rgyal ri bo chen po shar phyogs tshe lung dpal 'bar 'brag (brag) ri nas brnyed de/ slar shing 'brug zla ba lnga yi tshes bzang po/ skyang ri brag dkar rin chen rtse rdzong kyis (gyi) gnas zhal gsar du snang ba dang ldan (lhan) du sprul pa'i shog ser la zhal bshus te bris mkhan gnyis kyis 'phral 'gral (bris) byas pa'i dge tshogs/ bstan 'gro yongs la smin te bde legs phun sum tshogs pa'i snang bas rgyun du khyab par gyur cig/
